generation.cancel: POST returned cancel_url only when every job queued; 202 empty, 400 if started

generation.identity: Persist request_id immediately and write once; local unknown-submission is not provider status
generation.retention: Default 604800s from terminal time; Hf-Expires-After 3600..accountRetention only shortens. expires_at output expiry. Uploaded/reuse input copies independent <=7 days. referenceTraining.identity: id distinct from request_id; own account; matching v1/v2/cinema

idempotency.key: 1..255 visible ASCII, no whitespace; account scoped through key rotation
idempotency.replay: same request ID; acceptance receipt may still say queued; fetch current status
idempotency.policy: Never automatically retry uncertain submissions; reconcile/explicit authorized recovery only. No auto-new key on 422. Training/upload/estimate replay protection not established.

webhooks.query: hf_webhook HTTPS public endpoint, JSON POST, <=10s response
webhooks.signature: Standard Webhooks; raw body; timestamp ±5min; webhook-id dedupe; HMAC SHA256 with decoded whsec_ secret; rotation old valid24h; created only on console reveal (not performed)
webhooks.delivery: 2xx after durable record; network/5xx retry <=2h, 4xx permanent; stop after deletion; fallback polling
webhooks.hostLimitation: Current webhookReceiver kind pebble is not a generic Higgsfield ingress; polling baseline until accepted generic authenticated ingress.

costPolicy.authoritative: authenticated exact-parameter account quote, not indicative catalog/minimum/discount/cashback; decimal USD to exact integer usd_micro only when representable; precision unknown refuses
costPolicy.sum: separate ceilings by exact unit; unknown separate; never sum incomparable units
costPolicy.approval: Watt approval required before every paid proof; purpose/model/parameters/basis/max/per-vendor+aggregate ledger; approval maximum never self-authorizes
costPolicy.billing: Successful generations charged; failed/nsfw not charged; queued canceled refunded; balance funds expire1year
costPolicy.submission: No paid submit studio or pipeline without fresh safe estimate. Provider estimate or source-verified safe bounded deterministic actual tariff with exact inputs/basis/expiry only.

unknownUi.freshApproval: Approve N units for this step
unknownUi.aboveBudget: Above this run’s budget. Later steps still stop for approval.
